2607.06993.title: Large Behavior Model: A Promptable Digital Twin of the Retail Customer
2607.06993.paper_summary: Customer behavior modeling underpins recommendation, marketing, and decision support, yet existing approaches either optimize predictive accuracy without explaining decisions or simulate users without grounding them in real behavioral data. We present the Large Behavioral Model (LBM) that learns customer decision making directly from large-scale retail transactions through a unified Person-Environment formulation. Customer state is represented by a behavioral profile derived from historical purchases, while product context is incorporated through retrieval-augmented generation. The model is trained using continued pre-training on verbalized behavioral data, supervised fine-tuning for decision generation, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for evidence-based calibration. We evaluate the proposed framework on purchase prediction, hard-negative discrimination, basket completion, promotion response, and cross-domain voucher redemption. The model consistently outperforms frontier general-purpose language models on in-domain retail tasks while demonstrating strong zero-shot and fine-tuned transfer across retailers and decision domains. Ablation studies show that continued pre-training is the primary driver of behavioral generalization, retrieval is most effective when applied during both training and inference, and reinforcement learning improves reliance on explicit behavioral evidence over generic language-model priors. These results demonstrate that behavioral knowledge encoded in transaction histories can be effectively learned by language models, providing a scalable foundation for customer digital twins and behavior simulation.
2607.06993.paper_summary_zh: 顧客行為建模是推薦、行銷和決策支持的基礎，但現有的方法要麼優化預測準確性而不解釋決策，要麼模擬用戶卻不以真實行為數據為基礎。我們提出了大型行為模型（LBM），該模型通過統一的人-環境公式直接從大規模零售交易中學習顧客決策。顧客狀態由從歷史購買中得出的行為檔案表示，而產品上下文則通過檢索增強生成來納入。該模型使用對口語化行為數據的持續預訓練、用於決策生成的監督微調，以及通過可驗證獎勵進行的強化學習來進行訓練，以實現基於證據的校準。我們在購買預測、困難負樣本識別、購物籃完成、促銷反應和跨領域優惠券兌換等方面評估了所提出的框架。該模型在內域零售任務上始終超越前沿通用語言模型，同時在零售商和決策領域之間展示出強大的零樣本和微調轉移能力。消融研究表明，持續預訓練是行為泛化的主要驅動力，檢索在訓練和推理過程中應用時最為有效，而強化學習提高了對明確行為證據的依賴程度，超過了通用語言模型的先驗知識。這些結果表明，交易歷史中編碼的行為知識可以被語言模型有效學習，為顧客數位雙胞胎和行為模擬提供可擴展的基礎。
